title: Goal Contributions Across Europe’s Top Five Football Leagues (2021–2022)
text: Across 2,920 individual players in the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, and Ligue 1 during the 2021–2022 season, total goal contributions (goals plus assists) rise steadily with playing time, but the rate of production depends heavily on position. Elite forwards separate sharply from the rest of the field—led by Kylian Mbappé (46 goal contributions), Karim Benzema (39), Robert Lewandowski (38), and Mohamed Salah (36)—while midfielders form a middle tier and defenders and goalkeepers rarely exceed five contributions even with over 3,000 minutes played.

title: About
text:
About This Project
This project explores how goal contributions (goals plus assists) vary across playing time, position, and age for 2,920 individual football players in Europe’s Top 5 domestic leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, and Ligue 1) during the 2021–2022 season.

Data Source
Player match and season statistics come from the 2021–2022 Football Player Stats dataset compiled from FBref and hosted on Kaggle.
